verdict.rationale: LM Studio documents llmster as a headless daemon that needs no desktop app. Nothing in the evidence describes fast cold-start times or a lightweight binary that cuts the wait before inference. On-demand loading only says a model is loaded before the request returns, which implies a load wait rather than a fast cold start. The headless option is adjacent to the story but does not evidence the capability itself.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can get a fast cold start from a lightweight runtime binary instead of waiting seconds before inference begins
